breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the actual varying bending moment M(x) = P(L − x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ L, rather than the incorrect constant peak value M = PL over the full span. It properly integrates this varying moment to obtain U(P) = P²L³/(6EI) and then differentiates to get δ = PL³/(3EI), which matches the ground truth approach.
